leaders.name: Naveed Hussain
leaders.message: As the founder, my vision has always been to create a reliable, safe, and comfortable travel experience for all our passengers. Whether you’re commuting to work, embarking on a family trip, or exploring new destinations, we are dedicated to providing a seamless journey from start to finish. With a focus on safety, efficiency, and customer satisfaction, we’re not just moving people – we’re connecting communities. Thank you for choosing us as your travel partner.
leaders.image_alt: Naveed Hussain, Founder of Shaheen Express

leaders.name: Zahid Khan
leaders.message: When we started Shaheen Express, my goal was simple: to make travel more accessible, convenient, and enjoyable for everyone. Over the years, we’ve grown into a company that not only meets the highest standards of safety and reliability but also values each passenger’s unique journey. Our buses aren’t just a means of transport – they represent our commitment to comfort, punctuality, and exceptional service. It’s my privilege to welcome you aboard, and I look forward to being part of your travel experience
leaders.image_alt: Zahid Khan, Leader of Shaheen Express
